292 """Create a Buffer from a raw pointer. 

293  

294 When ``mr`` is provided, the buffer takes ownership: ``mr.deallocate()`` 

295 is called when the buffer is closed or garbage collected. When ``owner`` 

296 is provided, the owner is kept alive but no deallocation is performed. 

297 When ``mr`` is provided, a deallocation stream is recorded at creation 

298 (``stream`` if given, otherwise ``default_stream()``). Recording a 

299 default-stream token requires a CUDA context to be current. Host-only 

300 resources (``mr.is_device_accessible`` is ``False``) record no stream 

301 and need no context. 

302 """

347 @staticmethod 

348 def _reduce_helper(mr, ipc_descriptor): 

349 cdef ContextHandle h_ctx = get_current_context() 

350 cdef int device_id 

351 if not h_ctx: 

352 # Spawned processes unpickle arguments before entering their target, 

353 # so initialize the context needed to bind the default-stream token. 

354 device_id = mr.device_id 

355 (Device(device_id) if device_id >= 0 else Device()).set_current() 

356 # The parent process's stream is not portable across processes, so the 

357 # pickle path cannot thread an explicit stream through. Seed the 

358 # imported buffer's deallocation with the current context's default 

359 # stream; the receiver can override it before or during close. 

360 return Buffer.from_ipc_descriptor(mr, ipc_descriptor, stream=default_stream())

802 Subclasses must implement methods for allocating and deallocation, as well 

803 as properties associated with this memory resource from which all allocated 

804 buffers will inherit. (Since all :class:`Buffer` instances allocated and 

805 returned by the :meth:`allocate` method would hold a reference to self, the 

806 buffer properties are retrieved simply by looking up the underlying memory

820 ``device.default_stream`` to use the default stream. For subclasses 

821 that support stream-ordered deallocation, this stream also orders 

822 the buffer's eventual deallocation, so if the buffer may be freed 

823 from a different host thread, prefer a stream other than the

825 each thread.
